name: FX_Fountain_Spray

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha; 8 x 8 frames of 256 px, row by row from the top left

source_note: the frames are generated by the build script (seeded, deterministic); the .blend holds the dusk review scene with the mid frame on a card
dresses: fountain spray: a jet of drops thrown 1.1 m up and falling back as a veil, looping
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, no effect asset built
known_weaknesses: PARTIAL. Fifteen hundred ballistic drops drawn as soft streaks in a side view, with a touch of mist at the foot: no refraction, no sheet or column of water, no splash rings in the basin. A flipbook, not an effect: 64 frames of 256 px on one 2048 px atlas for a camera-facing billboard. It is drawn in 2D, so it casts no light, has no depth against the scene (soft-particle fade is engine work), and seen from above it is still a side view. The beauty render is the mid frame on an emissive card at dusk, not a volume. No Niagara system, material or light is authored here.
